listing.name: The Sword of Etheria — Sword-Of-Etheria-PC-Recomp (AncletoCEO)
listing.summary: This experimental build reaches boot, disc access, GS and a frame loop. Gameplay has not been established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European PAL SLES53768 disc and ELF.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the local CMake, Ghidra and recompilation instructions. The author’s Ps2Recomp-of-etheria framework fork is a possible helper; this guide does not establish it as a separate player.

warnings: This experimental build reaches boot, disc access, GS and a frame loop. Gameplay has not been established.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
